name: Peptide Hydrogel Prediction
short_description: ML system predicting hydrogel formation of short peptides from amino-acid sequence and terminal modifications. ROC-AUC 0.888 for amyloid, 0.720 for hydrogel; SHAP interpretability; strict leakage prevention.
detailed_description: Machine-learning models predicting hydrogel formation of short peptides from their amino-acid sequence and terminal modifications. Trained on a reconstructed SAPdb benchmark with rigorous leakage prevention, evaluated on a sealed test set and an expanded curated external literature set. Includes a multi-page Flask web application portal for authorized users.

biotech: Multi-page Flask portal with researcher auth
freelance: Research ML project from benchmarking through deployment

highlights: Multi-page Flask portal with training, prediction, and de-novo design scoring
